data.current_description: Returns one ingest only when it is owned directly by the token subject. A missing ingest and an ingest owned by another user produce the same not-found response.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve a specific owned ingest by ID
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves a single ingest by its ID, but only if it is owned directly by the token subject. Requires the ingest_id path parameter. Returns the ingest object with its publishing credentials on success. Returns a 404 not-found response both when the ingest does not exist and when the ingest is owned by another user, preventing unauthorized access disclosure. Publishing credentials in the response are marked private and no-store.
